description: Header file defining the t_server structure and functions for the SRP (Secure Remote Password) server-side protocol implementation, including negotiation, key generation, and verification.

methods.name: t_serveropen
methods.description: Initializes an SRP server session with a username.

methods.name: t_serveropenfromfiles
methods.description: Initializes an SRP server session using password and configuration files.

methods.name: t_serveropenraw
methods.description: Initializes an SRP server session with raw password entry.

methods.name: t_servergenexp
methods.description: Generates a random 256-bit exponent for SRP.

methods.name: t_servergetkey
methods.description: Computes the session key from the client's exponential.

methods.name: t_serverresponse
methods.description: Computes the session key proof for verification.

methods.name: t_serverclose
methods.description: Closes the SRP server session and frees resources.
